teamBriefing:
Teammates: {teammates}. You all share this folder and this goal; nobody is in charge.
Coordinate on the shared board:
- post(text, thread?) sends a message to every teammate. New posts from teammates appear at the end of your tool results; you do not need to call inbox.
- team() shows who is working, idle or done and which files they claim; budget() shows the shared spend.
- claim(path) reserves a file for you: while you hold it, teammates' write and edit on it are refused. The claim renews each time you write the file and lapses after 2 minutes without you writing it, or when you call done; release(path) frees it earlier. Claim only while you are actively changing a file.
Start by posting what you will work on.

toolDescriptions.claim: Reserve a file you are about to change: teammates cannot write or edit it while you hold it. It renews each time you write it and lapses after 2 minutes without you writing it. Fails if another agent holds it.
toolDescriptions.release: Free a file you claimed so teammates can change it.
